newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDESpar and CVRD employees sign deal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDESpar and CVRD employees sign deal.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) and state mining giant CVRD have signed an agreement for a partnership between the bank's investment arm BNDESpar and CVRD's employees to take part jointly in the privatization process of CVRD.
A 45 percent voting stake in CVRD will be auctioned April 29 for a minimum price of 3 billion reais ($2.83 billion) as a first step in the privatization of the company.
A staff and global offer will complete the process of selling off the government's entire 51 percent stake in CVRD.
Under the agreement, BNDESpar and CVRD employees will seek to join whichever consortium emerges as the winning bidder from the privatization auction, said BNDESpar Director Durval Soledade.
"We are not negotiating with any consortium at the moment, only after the auction," he said.
BNDESpar already holds 3.24 percent of CVRD's voting stock, while CVRD employees will be able to acquire 4.45 percent of CVRD voting stock under the privatization rules.
Their joint holdings would give the new owners of the 45 percent voting stake, dubbed Valecom, a controlling position within CVRD.
Soledade said BNDESpar might also buy additional CVRD voting stock to increase the stake in Valecom.
He said BNDESpar would say prior to the auction how much it would spend on acquiring additional CVRD voting shares.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
